_comment: Accepted local data-quality audit exceptions. Keep explicit IDs small; use accepted_issue_types only for categories whose behavior is intentionally non-actionable.

accepted_issue_types.catalog_box_set_missing_spine: Criterion box set pages do not always map to a standalone public spine in the catalog data; regular /films/ spine gaps remain actionable.
accepted_issue_types.pick_box_set_missing_spine: Box set picks can intentionally carry a /boxsets/ URL without a pick-level catalog_spine; regular /films/ spine gaps remain actionable.

film_missing_tmdb_id.the-brd-trilogy: Three-film Fassbinder collection; the old id 1712202 no longer resolves on TMDB.
film_missing_tmdb_id.pierre-etaix: Five-film Pierre Etaix collection; the old match was Odile Etaix's 2011 documentary about him, Pierre Etaix, un destin anime (388062).
film_missing_tmdb_id.the-three-musketeers-the-four-musketeers: Two Richard Lester films from 1973 and 1974; the old match was Pierre Aknine's unrelated 2005 French TV film D'Artagnan et les Trois Mousquetaires (119900).
film_missing_tmdb_id.small-axe: Five-film Steve McQueen anthology; the old match was the unrelated Big Plane Small Axe - the mistrial of Mary Kelly (1533099).
film_missing_tmdb_id.i-am-curious: Two-film Vilgot Sjoman release (Yellow and Blue); the old match was Stig Bjorkman's 1995 documentary I Am Curious, Film (498376).
film_missing_tmdb_id.zatoichi-the-blind-swordsman: Twenty-five-film Zatoichi series box set; the old match was Takeshi Kitano's unrelated 2003 Zatoichi (246).
film_missing_tmdb_id.the-infernal-affairs-trilogy: Three-film Infernal Affairs collection; the old id 1599219 no longer resolves on TMDB.
film_missing_tmdb_id.the-emigrantsthe-new-land: Jan Troell double feature; the old match was the interview supplement Coming to America: Jan Troell on 'The Emigrants' and 'The New Land' (574800). Twin of the already-accepted the-emigrants-jan-troell-double-feature row.
